howToApply: Visit the official OJAS website: https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in
Ensure you have completed OTR (One Time Registration) on the OJAS website before applying.
Click on ‘Online Application’ and then ‘Apply’, then select GSSSB.
Click on the advertisement for ‘Work Assistant, Class-3’ (Advertisement No. 461/202627) and then click ‘Apply Now’.
Enter your Registration Number and Date of Birth, then click ‘Apply with OTR’ to open the Application Format.
Fill in Personal Details as per your OTR registration (mandatory fields marked with red asterisk *).
Fill in SSC details (Roll Number, month and year of passing, name as per marksheet, Board name, etc.).
Enter Bank Account details (name as per passbook, bank name, IFSC code, account number) for fee refund purposes and upload the first page of your passbook in JPEG/JPG/PNG format.
Fill in Educational Details.
Accept the Declaration by selecting ‘Yes�� and click ‘Save’. An Application Number will be generated — save it carefully.

Upload Passport-size photograph (5 cm height x 3.6 cm width) and Signature (2.5 cm height x 7.5 cm width) in JPG format (max 15 KB each). The photo must have a white background, include the date of the photograph, and must not be older than 1 year from the last date of application.
Click ‘Confirm Application’, verify all details, and if correct, confirm. Once confirmed, no changes can be made. A Confirmation Number will be generated — save it for all future correspondence.
Print the application form and keep a copy for your records.
Pay the examination fee online (Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or Wallets) by 01/11/2026 (23:59 hours). Obtain and save the fee receipt/e-receipt.
